title: Speech Recognition Breakthrough for the Spoken, Translated Word
summary: Microsoft Research's Rick Rashid demonstrates a speech recognition and translation system, built on deep neural networks, that turns his spoken English into Chinese speech in 2012.
why: HN cites it as an early impressive real-time speech translation demo, often in discussions of voice-preserving translation and later AI demos.

quote.text: Check out this real-time translation of spoken English into written and spoken Chinese (in the same voice of the speaker)
